options.name: autoremove
options.description: Calls C(pkg_delete -a) to remove automatically installed packages which are no longer needed.

options.name: build
options.description: Build the package from source instead of downloading and installing a binary. Requires that the port source tree is already installed. Automatically builds and installs the C(sqlports) package, if it is not already installed. Mutually exclusive with O(snapshot).

options.name: clean
options.description: When updating or removing packages, delete the extra configuration file(s) in the old packages which are annotated with C(@extra) in the packaging-list.

options.name: name
options.description: A name or a list of names of the packages.

options.name: ports_dir
options.description: When used in combination with the O(build) option, allows overriding the default ports source directory.

options.name: quick
options.description: Replace or delete packages quickly; do not bother with checksums before removing normal files.

options.name: snapshot
options.description: Force C(%c) and C(%m) to expand to C(snapshots), even on a release kernel. Mutually exclusive with O(build).

options.name: state
options.description: V(present) ensures the package is installed. V(latest) ensures the latest version of the package is installed. V(absent) ensures the specified package is not installed.
